Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC task-7ad36d70: bring marker to the 2-bar and add an 8-stripe

Grid contains a uniform background, a full-length line of color 2, and a compact non-background object somewhere on one side of that line. The bar can be horizontal or vertical; the object may be separated from it by a gap or already touching it.

## Transformation
1. Find the full-length color-2 line (horizontal or vertical).
2. Find the compact object on one side of the line. Translate the whole object along the perpendicular axis toward the 2-line until its nearest edge is immediately adjacent to the 2-line. Preserve its exact shape and colors. Clear its old location when it is moved (do not leave a duplicate).
3. On the object's side away from the 2-line, recolor the next full-length parallel line to color 8 (one cell beyond the moved object's far edge). Keep the 2-line and all unrelated cells unchanged.

Validated evidence:
- Demo 22x30: horizontal 2-line at row 4; complex color-0 object at rows 12–19 is translated upward to rows 5–12, immediately below the bar; original shape location is cleared; full row 13 is changed to 8.
- Fresh 16x7 test: horizontal 2-line at row 3; three color-4 cells at row 9, cols 2–4 move to row 4 (immediately below bar); old row 9 is cleared; full row 5 becomes 8. This output was accepted. Two incorrect alternatives were placing 8 at the original object's row or just below its original position without moving the object.
- Existing validated contact cases have the object already adjacent to the bar, so no translation is needed: add the 8-line immediately beyond the object's far edge, away from the bar (e.g. vertical bar col 5, adjacent object col 4, output 8 at col 3).

Important: orient the action based on the full 2-line. Move/translate object along the direction perpendicular to the bar, not parallel to it. Then add the full 8 stripe on the object's far side. The demonstrated translation clears the source; preserve the object only in its new adjacent location. For an object already touching the bar, the 8 stripe is the immediately adjacent full line on the object's far side (not a distant edge or the original background boundary). Fresh vertical confirmation: in an 11x9 grid with a full 2-bar in the rightmost column and a single 6 at row 4, column 8 (1-indexed), leave the 6 in place and make column 7 entirely 8; the 2-bar and the marker remain unchanged.
